selling / acquisition expenses, general and administrative expenses, operating profit and profit before tax of investment contracts: not printed (IFRS 4: the activity is not presented as a segment; the table prints only 'מרווח פיננסי כולל דמי ניהול' for the whole yield-dependent column of life policies, which is not investment-contract specific).

investment_contract_aum (liabilities for yield-dependent investment contracts): not separately printed in the interim report; the balance sheet and notes print only the combined 'התחייבויות בגין חוזי ביטוח וחוזי השקעה תלויי תשואה'. notes: Source: the insurer's own consolidated report on MAYA (איילון חברה לביטוח בע"מ). Amounts in NIS thousand as printed.
Page = 1-based PDF page of the MAYA PDF.

IFRS 4 report: investment contracts are not presented as a segment. The receipts figure is the row 'תקבולים בגין חוזי השקעה שנזקפו ישירות לעתודות ביטוח' in the segment-note table 'נתונים נוספים על אודות מגזר ביטוח חיים וחיסכון ארוך טווח'; the total column equals the yield-dependent column (policies from 2004). Windows: q = three months, ytd = six / nine months, fy = full year. Figures differ from the IFRS 17 restated comparatives printed in the 2025 reports (for example Q1-24: 48,401 here, 47,371 restated).
